# Cloudspital

> Cloudspital (Cloudspital Private Limited) is an Indian medtech manufacturer of Health ATM kiosks, Tele ICU / Tele PICU systems, telemedicine carts, point-of-care testing devices, and mobile medical units. AIIMS co-developed, DPIIT (Startup India) recognised, GeM listed, CDSCO approved, and ABDM/ABHA integrated. Headquartered in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with manufacturing in Kasna Industrial Area; deploys across India.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Cloudspital Private Limited
- Founded: 2021
- Head office: UG-04, Tower 4, NX One, Noida Extension, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh 201318, India
- Factory: Plot No. K-138, Kasna Industrial Area, Surajpur Site V, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201312, India
- Phone: +91 75420 11187 / +91 62073 76706
- Email: subham@cloudspital.ai
- Area served: India (deployments incl. Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand, West Bengal, Indian Railways)
- Compliance & recognition: CDSCO approved devices, ISO 13485, DPIIT / Startup India recognised, GeM listed, ABDM / NDHM compliant, ABHA integration
- Clinical collaboration: co-developed and validated with AIIMS clinicians (incl. AIIMS Patna Tele-PICU)

## Core solutions
- [Health ATM Kiosk](https://cloudspital.ai/health-atm-kiosk/): self-service kiosk screening 30+ vital and metabolic parameters in minutes with integrated telemedicine.
- [Tele ICU and Tele PICU](https://cloudspital.ai/tele-icu/): hub-and-spoke remote critical care connecting district/rural hospitals to intensivists 24x7.
- [Telemedicine and Point of Care](https://cloudspital.ai/telemedicine/): telemedicine carts, portable telemedicine bags, and POCT with eSanjeevani integration.
- [Government and Public Health Kiosks](https://cloudspital.ai/government-health-kiosk/): ABDM/ABHA integrated, GeM-procurable kiosks for government hospitals, PHCs and Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.
- [Mobile Medical Unit](https://cloudspital.ai/mobile-medical-unit/): fully equipped MMUs for rural health camps and outreach.
- [Products catalog](https://cloudspital.ai/products/): Medsync I–VI carts, health kiosks and mobile medical unit.
- [Diagnostic test catalog](https://cloudspital.ai/tests/): 50+ point-of-care tests (biochemistry, immunoassays, rapid panels, strip tests).
